programs.Qilou01: 三栋原创广式骑楼小样，相通的前廊接到茶楼侧廊；总尺寸 76 × 40 × 52 格。平铺测试底座，尚未扩展为完整街区。
programs.Grocery: 两层杂货铺：首层陈列、结账、备货与厨房；楼上卧室、盥洗、起居和餐桌。窄小货架、木墙裙、靠窗长座与床组分别服务经营和住家。
programs.Apothecary: 三层药铺：一层药柜、称量、咨询与等候；二层库存、分装和账房；三层居住与餐厨。立面以凹阳台、浅色柱式和栏杆区别于相邻店屋。
programs.Teahouse: 三层转角茶楼：一层茶座、备餐与清洗；二层多组茶桌、窗边长座与服务柜；三层住家、厨房、餐桌和书柜。双面骑楼廊、退切转角与圆窗形成街角识别。

facade_recipes.Grocery: 朴素两层 / 面宽 15 格
facade_recipes.Apothecary: 凹阳台三层 / 面宽 17 格
facade_recipes.Teahouse: 退切转角三层 / 面宽 23 格

implementation_mapping.decision: Four-block front arcade and side arcade, integrated shop sign, clear doorway
implementation_mapping.validation: audit_qilou.py: entire arcade bounds and three reachable entrances

implementation_mapping.decision: Recessed balconies and separated column/parapet layers on Apothecary
implementation_mapping.validation: four elevations, front close-up, balcony use points

implementation_mapping.decision: Authored tea-room groups, service sideboard and kitchen separate from guest area
implementation_mapping.validation: Tea ground and upper plan, use points, interior views

scope_notes: Uses the established HAF 0.4 workflow; case version Qilou01 is not a new universal engine version.
Seeds change plant species only; three building/facade/furniture recipes are authored.
15/17/23-block widths are playability experiments, not measured historic frontage.
No actual client gameplay, medical use or historical business identity claimed.
Image rendering uses actual NBT and local official assets with recorded approximations.
